title: alnus cordata var. rotundifolia
intro: Alnus cordata var. rotundifolia, commonly known as Japanese green alder or green-leaved alder, is a variety of deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Betulaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Alnus cordata var. rotundifolia include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
